# Contributing to VIGIL

Documentation fixes, reproducible bug reports and focused code improvements are
welcome. Start with the [contributor guide](../docs/development/CONTRIBUTING.md)
for local setup, tests and source exports.

Explain the problem your change solves and how you checked it. Changes to
execution or scoring must preserve the documented benchmark contract and include
relevant evidence. Run the affected tests; see the guide for the full release checks.

For a larger feature or a new experimental contract, describe the intended use
in an issue so the scope can be discussed before implementation.
